title: Machame Route
summary: Climb from rainforest to the Shira area, then follow the southern slopes through Barranco and Karanga. Seven mountain days include the summit attempt and descent through Mweka.

photos.alt: Trekkers on the Machame route approaching Lava Tower beneath Kibo
photos.caption: The approach to Lava Tower, with Kibo rising above the Machame trail.

photos.alt: Tents and a shelter on rocky terrain at Barafu Camp
photos.caption: Barafu high camp, the staging point for the summit attempt.

photos.alt: An illuminated orange tent below Kibo in evening light
photos.caption: Evening light on Kibo: a glimpse of camping on Kilimanjaro.

title: Lemosho Route
theme: A western approach across the Shira Plateau
summary: Approach from the western forest and walk across the Shira Plateau before joining the southern circuit. Eight mountain days allow a gradual journey through the plateau stages before the summit attempt.

photos.alt: Kilimanjaro seen from Shira camp in warm evening light
photos.caption: A view from Shira camp across the plateau on the Lemosho journey.

photos.alt: Kibo above a lit orange tent at a Kilimanjaro campsite
photos.caption: Kibo at dusk: mountain camping beneath Kilimanjaro’s highest peak.

photos.alt: Trekkers on the rocky approach to Lava Tower with Kibo behind them
photos.caption: Lava Tower on the shared southern circuit, photographed from the Machame approach.

title: Marangu Route
summary: Follow the eastern route through forest and moorland, staying in mountain huts. The six-day plan includes the Horombo acclimatisation day before the summit objective and return on the same route.

photos.alt: A path through Kilimanjaro’s dense montane rainforest
photos.caption: Kilimanjaro’s montane rainforest, the landscape of the lower mountain.

photos.alt: David beside mountain huts on the Marangu route
photos.caption: Marangu huts · a guiding photograph supplied by David Explora.

photos.alt: Two trekkers beside the Uhuru Peak summit sign
photos.caption: At Uhuru Peak: a summit photograph supplied by David Explora.
